title: Schema
description: Meta-schema for the documents in this directory: JSON Schema draft-07 documents named in kebab-case, one entity per file, linked with relative $ref pointers.

$schema.description: Must be the draft-07 metaschema URI.

$id.description: Optional stable identifier for the document.

description.description: What the schema describes and how it relates to other schemas.

allOf.description: Combined schemas, used for versioned and source event variants.

$ref.description: Relative pointer to a sibling schema file.

examples.title: Example
examples.description: Minimal document conforming to this meta-schema.
